top_signals.title: Japan Auto Stocks Eye Rebound as Cheaper Oil Brightens Outlook
top_signals.summary: Japanese automaker shares have surged since the US midterm elections, but their rebound may just be getting started, as the prospects of easing Middle East tensions and lower oil prices will likely have long-term implications for the industry, according to investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
